name: codex-deepseek-subagent
tagline: Register DeepSeek V4 Flash as a native Codex subagent with automated setup
description: codex-deepseek-subagent is a skill that registers DeepSeek V4 Flash as a native Codex subagent with automated setup and verified routing. The API key is read via stdin and stored in the system keychain (Keychain on macOS, Credential Manager on Windows). It includes status checks, tests, repair, disable, and uninstall flows, and verifies model_provider, model, reasoning_effort, agent_role, and a NATIVE_DEEPSEEK_OK token before reporting success.
highlights: Registers DeepSeek V4 Flash as a native Codex subagent
Automated setup with API key stored in the system keychain
Verified routing checks model_provider, model, reasoning_effort, and agent_role
Status, test, repair, disable, and uninstall commands
From the same author as oil-motion
curatorNote: Cheap DeepSeek as a Codex subagent, with real verification instead of hope. Practical, focused, and useful for anyone who wants an inexpensive second opinion in their coding loop.
